petalCurve.method: piecewise radial/up profile fitted by eye to street, aerial and interior photographs, constrained by source outer/inner rings and reported overall height; no calibrated scan or structural section
petalCurve.uncertainty: tips ±3m, inner roof edge ±5m, bulge/roof sweep ±8m, thickness ±.25m, curve phase ±half a petal pitch;59.4m uses operator height with datum conflict pending

petalWidth.method: broad outer blades and narrow translucent interleaving blades visible in ground and aerial views;55 source count does not determine seam placement
petalWidth.uncertainty: width/small-petal height ±20%; independent27-small distribution is approximate; north entrance asymmetry pending

bowl.method: three visible seating tiers in actual NBBJ interior photo; representative football/running layout proportioned to the mapped opening, with tier heights and seat rows reduced for candidate budget
bowl.uncertainty: tier height ±4m, track axes ±10m, standard pitch dimensions are a representation choice not surveyed stadium dimensions; permanent field/current event deck pending

entranceRhythm.method: recurring gaps/columns behind independent petal tips; a slot per large-petal cadence represents street permeability without asserting signed gate names
entranceRhythm.uncertainty: phase ±half-pitch; true gate count/labels/entry level unknown; exact large gap and current entrance use pending

roofRibs.method: coarse curve-following ribs and transverse seams, informed by photographed panel/louver rhythm and reported pipe trusses; representative not structural simulation
roofRibs.uncertainty: rib and seam dimensions ±50%; full structural bracing/connectors and panel inventory unknown

notes: Actual Blender export bound to hashes. Ground, collision, in-game appearance, day/night and performance remain unknown.

glbStats.scope: selected object meshes; bytes refer to whole shared GLB
